# SageCG Venture Studio — Complete Portfolio & Technical Reference Corpus (llms-full.txt)

> Canonical Domain: https://www.sagecg.com
> Parent Entity: Sage Consulting Group, Inc. (Est. 1998)
> Founder & Operator: Rob Pfleghardt (rob@sagecg.com)
> Headquarters & Presence: Dual anchors in Vienna, Virginia (504 Mashie Drive, Vienna, VA 22180) and South Carolina.

---

## 1. Studio Thesis & Operating Model

SageCG is an operator-led software venture studio. Unlike accelerators that pick winners or holding companies that acquire them, SageCG starts, architects, builds, and operates every company in its portfolio from the inside on a shared engineering and back-office spine.

### Four Operating Principles
1. **Operator-first:** Every company in the portfolio is one we run ourselves. We do not ship ideas we wouldn't show up to on a Monday.
2. **Built to last:** Profitable, durable, useful. Optimized for compounding cash flow over fundraising, with 100% independent ownership and zero outside capital.
3. **Shared spine:** One studio, one back office (entity formation, legal, Stripe billing, compliance), and one modern edge engineering stack so new ventures ship in days.
4. **Independent brands:** Each commercial venture stands on its own domain, brand identity, customer base, and unit economics.

### Four Bars Every Commercial Venture Clears
- **01 Real pain:** A specific operator or customer is losing time or money to a broken workflow and will pay to make it stop.
- **02 Fair market:** Big enough to build a durable business, specialized enough that legacy incumbents move too slowly.
- **03 Operator edge:** Deep domain expertise, proprietary statutory synthesis, or technical leverage provides an unfair head start.
- **04 Durable shape:** High gross margins and a direct path to profitable, compounding cash flow without external venture dilution.

## 2. In Market Commercial Ventures (5 Operating Companies)

### 2.1 LeaderReps LLC
- **Case Study:** https://www.sagecg.com/portfolio/leaderreps/
- **Primary Domain:** https://www.leaderreps.com
- **Application PWA:** https://arena.leaderreps.com
- **Sector:** B2B SaaS · Leadership Development (HR Tech)
- **Founded:** 2023 | **Status:** In Market
- **Tagline:** Leadership conditioning for managers — built through reps, not slide decks.
- **Problem Solved:** 82% of managers are promoted without formal training, and one-day workshops fail to change daily behavior.
- **What Ships:**
  - **Foundation Cohort Program:** Structured leadership conditioning across *Lead Yourself, Lead Others, Lead the Work*.
  - **Real Reps:** Deliberate practice exercises integrated directly into a manager's actual workday.
  - **The Arena PWA:** Dedicated conditioning app (`arena.leaderreps.com`) for tracking progress, tools, and daily reps.
  - **AI Coaching & Evaluation:** ~170 Firebase Cloud Functions running Google Gemini 2.5 (with Anthropic Claude fallback) for rep scoring and coaching, plus Telnyx SMS workflows and lead-magnet diagnostic calculators.

### 2.2 CBR Labs LLC
- **Case Study:** https://www.sagecg.com/portfolio/cbr-labs/
- **Primary Domain:** https://www.cbr-labs.com
- **Admin & Custody App:** https://www.cbr-labs.com/admin
- **Sector:** GovTech · Secure Hardware Services
- **Founded:** 2025 | **Status:** In Market
- **Tagline:** SCIF-Compliant Hardware Redaction for Government Tablets.
- **Problem Solved:** SCIFs, courtrooms, operating rooms, and correctional facilities prohibit recording/transmitting devices, and MDM software locks or tape fail physical security audits.
- **What Ships:**
  - **Permanent Board-Level Redaction:** Physical removal of cameras, microphones, speakers, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and RF antennas from iPad and Android tablets.
  - **NIST 800-171 Compliance & Chain of Custody:** Append-only custody event log backed by Cloudflare D1 and R2 photo evidence.
  - **Cryptographic Certificate of Redaction:** Serial-numbered PDF certificates paired with a public verification endpoint for CSOs and contracting officers.

### 2.3 VoraPrep LLC
- **Case Study:** https://www.sagecg.com/portfolio/voraprep/
- **Primary Domain:** https://voraprep.com
- **Sector:** Consumer EdTech · Professional Certification Prep
- **Founded:** 2026 | **Status:** In Market
- **Tagline:** Master 30 professional certifications with active recall, statutory depth, and 1:1 exam simulation.
- **Problem Solved:** Candidates juggle 100–400 study hours around full-time jobs while legacy review providers charge $2,000–$3,000 for passive video lectures and static PDFs.
- **What Ships:**
  - **30 Full-Curriculum Certification Courses across 5 Kingdoms:**
    - *Accounting & Tax:* CPA, EA, CMA, CFE, CPP, CGFM
    - *Securities & Wealth:* CFP, SIE, FINRA Series 7, 63, 65, 66, 6, 24, 57, 79, 99, CFA Level 1, FRM Part 1
    - *Audit, Cyber & Privacy:* CISA, CIA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, CCSP, CompTIA Security+, CIPP/US
    - *HR Leadership:* SHRM-CP, PHR
    - *Federal Regulatory:* U.S. Customs Broker License Exam (CBLE)
  - **Scale & Depth:** 71,700+ verified MCQs with option-by-option rationales, 2,790+ textbook-grade interactive lessons, 13,800+ FSRS-4.5 spaced-repetition flashcards, and printable 12-week Study Plan PDFs.
  - **1:1 Exam Simulators & Vory AI Tutor:** Authentic Prometric, Pearson VUE, and PSI test-center simulators, GreenLight pass-probability predictor, Vory 24/7 Socratic AI tutor (Google Gemini), and Web + iOS/Android apps via Capacitor.

### 2.4 BorderSage
- **Case Study:** https://www.sagecg.com/portfolio/bordersage/
- **Primary Domain:** https://bordersage.com
- **Landed-Cost Calculator:** https://bordersage.com/calculator.html
- **Sector:** Global Trade · Customs & Tariff Intelligence
- **Founded:** 2026 | **Status:** In Market
- **Tagline:** Clear global customs with mathematical certainty.
- **Problem Solved:** Cross-border shippers rely on stale tariff PDFs and black-box broker estimates, discovering PGA holds, suspended *de minimis* thresholds, or missed 0% FTA exemptions only after freight is detained.
- **What Ships:**
  - **50-Country Sovereign Customs Blueprints (133 Dedicated Hub Pages):** Covers ~91% of global merchandise trade (US, UK, EU-27, Canada, Iceland, Norway, Switzerland, Mexico, Japan, South Korea, Australia, China, Singapore, New Zealand, GCC-6, Taiwan, Vietnam, India, Brazil).
  - **7-Layer Regulatory Synthesis:** Tariff Schedules & Rulings, Import VAT/GST & *De Minimis*, PGA Trigger Maps, FTAs & Duty Drawback, Export Controls & Sanctions, Valuation & Customs FX, and Official Filing Schemas.
  - **Active Interrogation HS Classifier & 4-Form Packets:** Deterministic HS classification, CIF/FOB landed-cost calculator, SHA-256 cryptographic statutory receipts, SKU Master Vault, and Enterprise REST API (`/api/v1/calculate`).

### 2.5 FoundInAnswers
- **Case Study:** https://www.sagecg.com/portfolio/foundinanswers/
- **Primary Domain:** https://foundinanswers.com
- **Customer Console:** https://foundinanswers.com/console
- **Sector:** B2B SaaS · Search & AI Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
- **Founded:** 2026 | **Status:** In Market
- **Tagline:** Get found across search engines & AI assistants — with zero AI slop.
- **Problem Solved:** Lean product websites (<10 pages) and mobile apps suffer from Soft-404 `/sitemap.xml` and `/llms.txt` traps, brand-only titles, and invisible App Store listings across Google, Bing, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude.
- **What Ships:**
  - **Step 1 Free Live Edge Audit & Custom Showroom:** Real-time 6-stage HTTP inspection of DOM metadata, XML sitemaps, `/robots.txt` AI crawler permissions, `/llms.txt`, JSON-LD schema, and Apple App Store / Google Play ASO metadata.
  - **100% Honest Audit Guarantee ($0/mo Verdict):** Sites that already pass technical SEO and AEO checks receive a 90–100/100 score and a **$0/mo (No Plan Needed)** recommendation.
  - **Two-Gate Founder Governance & Technical Bridge:** Gate 1 customizes the 6-Hub, 24-Spoke blueprint and voice guardrails before drafting; Gate 2 provides a full WYSIWYG Review & Approval Queue with a strict zero-em-dash human editorial policy, automated Tue/Thu drip publishing, and instant Microsoft Bing IndexNow pings.

### 3.1 The Longest Table
- **Case Study:** https://www.sagecg.com/portfolio/longest-table/

- **Summary:** Civic-tech platform for neighborhood long-table community dinners (powering The Longest Table Vienna on Mill Street SE), featuring an intentional guest-mixing seating engine, Table Captain portal, sponsor workflows, and town-wide RSVP check-in.

### 3.2 NFL Fantasy Auction Draft
- **Case Study:** https://www.sagecg.com/portfolio/football-draft/
- **Live URL:** https://annual-auction-nfl-draft-608a4.web.app/
- **Sector:** Consumer · Sports Analytics | **Founded:** 2023
- **Summary:** Real-time auction draft room for fantasy football leagues that auction all 32 NFL teams, featuring live ESPN FPI bid valuation, league budget-pressure modeling, Bargain/Fair/Overpay indicators, and a multi-season archive.
